title: Component Outcome Concentration and Economic-Role Robustness

research_height.transfer_path: Lifecycle contribution mass determines component-level rank and sign robustness, which determines how much weight existing book-role and future capital-allocation decisions may place on pooled averages.

central_question: Across both the fixed-0.01 CP2 and compounding binding lifecycle ledgers, do a component's ten largest stressed winners carry enough result mass that removing them changes component signs and rankings, making current economic-role evidence tail-dependent?

research_bundle.name: top_five_top_ten_mass_leave_top_ten_rank_and_book_role_robustness
lenses: mechanism: component-level top-5 and top-10 shares of gross positive stressed lifecycle value in each evidence basis
decision robustness: leave-top-10-out component net signs and six-component rank ordering within each basis
portfolio transfer and natural contrast: fixed-0.01 versus compounding robustness plus residual US30 and US100 book signs

idea_provenance.authority_note: The memo supplies the question and strong falsifier only. Project Zeta Terminus Next remains the sole economic authority. Cards 01 and 11 are represented only through already-closed Units 074 and 072; neither is reopened.

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 074 found an inverse turnover/value shape in most views but not a stable cross-period frontier, while Unit 072 classified US100 as a lower-yield positive-return sleeve. Both decisions use pooled component means and totals and therefore leave the distributional reliability of those roles unresolved.
why_now.connection_bridge: Unit 074's CP2 and binding component ranks differ materially, Pressure is the smallest binding component yet the second-largest binding net contributor, and Unit 072's US100 role depends on Cross plus Passive pooled net. The exact raw lifecycle ledgers for both evidence bases are already pinned and can test whether those conclusions survive removal of their largest ten observations.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 074 was Program 5 macro frequency/value aggregation. Unit 075 moves to Program 7 meso distributional reliability and causal-evidence strength, using individual lifecycle outcomes rather than component averages.
why_now.decision_if_true: Preserve all six components and current book construction, but downgrade pooled component rank and book-role totals as standalone capital-allocation evidence; any later allocation candidate must show predeclared tail-removal robustness.
why_now.decision_if_false: Treat the existing component signs, ranks and US100 positive-return role as distributionally robust to removal of the largest ten observations, without creating a new allocation policy.
why_now.decision_if_ambiguous_or_invalid: Preserve current roles and policies, record the bounded reliability result and rotate away.

unit_039_result.role: Authoritative CP2 component count and stressed 2x net anchors.

equivalence.role: Authoritative binding component count and stressed 2x net anchors.

frozen_reconstruction.row_selection: Concatenate the pinned files only within their named basis, retain physical rows with event exactly CLOSE and a mapped component_id, and parse finite numeric value_b as that lifecycle's stressed 2x net. CP2 keys are period plus state_sequence; binding keys are state_sequence. Every retained key must be unique.
frozen_reconstruction.lifecycle_tiebreak: Sort stressed net descending, then CP2 period order P1/P2/P3/P4, then numeric state_sequence, then component order. Binding omits period from that tie break.
frozen_reconstruction.top_k: For k=5 and k=10, take the first k lifecycle rows under the frozen lifecycle ordering independently within each component and basis.
frozen_reconstruction.gross_positive_share: Sum max(stressed_net,0) in the selected top-k rows divided by sum max(stressed_net,0) over every lifecycle in that component and basis. Every component must have positive gross positive value.
frozen_reconstruction.net_dependency_ratio: Top-k stressed-net sum divided by original component stressed net, reported only because every anchored original component net is positive; values above one mean the residual is negative.
frozen_reconstruction.leave_top_k_net: Original component stressed net minus the exact stressed-net sum of its top-k rows. No other row is altered or reweighted.
frozen_reconstruction.sign: POSITIVE when net is greater than 1e-9, NEGATIVE when below -1e-9, otherwise ZERO.
frozen_reconstruction.rank: Rank six components by descending net with component_order_tiebreak. Compare original versus leave-top-10 order using all 15 unordered component pairs.
frozen_reconstruction.rank_pair_reversals: Count a reversal when a component pair's strict order differs between original and leave-top-10 ranks. Kendall tau-a equals (15 minus two times reversals) divided by 15.
frozen_reconstruction.cross_basis_contrast: Report original and leave-top-10 pair reversals and Kendall tau-a between CP2 and binding ranks; this is descriptive and not a completion gate.
frozen_reconstruction.book_residual: Within each basis, sum original and leave-top-10 component nets for US30_BOOK and US100_BOOK using the frozen mapping. This tests role reliability only and cannot change Unit 072 by itself.

requirements: All 12 byte/hash pins, CSV header/schema anchors and prior source verdict anchors pass.
Every selected CLOSE row has one mapped component, a unique frozen key and finite value_b.
CP2 has exactly 2,233 rows and its six counts/nets match Unit 039 within 1e-9; binding has exactly 2,235 rows and its six counts/nets match equivalence within 1e-9.
Each component has at least 100 lifecycle rows, at least ten positive lifecycle rows and positive gross positive value in both bases.
In each basis, at least four of six components have top-10 gross-positive share at least 0.30.
The median of the six top-10 gross-positive shares is at least 0.35 in each basis.
In each basis, at least three of six originally positive component nets become nonpositive after removing that component's top ten lifecycle outcomes.
In each basis, at least three of 15 component pairs reverse and original-versus-residual Kendall tau-a is at most 0.60.
The fragility thesis is strongly falsified only when all six component signs remain positive and all 15 component pairs retain exact rank order after top-10 removal in both bases.

fixed_verdict_rules.complete: PASS_BROAD_OUTCOME_CONCENTRATION_COMPONENT_RANKS_TAIL_DEPENDENT when integrity, broad concentration, and sign/rank fragility all pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.falsified: NO_MATERIAL_OUTCOME_CONCENTRATION_COMPONENT_RANKS_ROBUST when integrity passes and the strong falsifier triggers.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_OUTCOME_CONCENTRATION_NO_DECISION_CHANGE when integrity passes and neither preceding rule applies.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_OUTCOME_CONCENTRATION_NO_VERDICT when any immutable, row, identity or density condition fails.

decision_translation.complete: Preserve realized economics, all six components and both books, but treat pooled component order and book totals as tail-dependent reliability evidence; a later capital-allocation proposal must independently predeclare and pass a tail-removal robustness lens.
decision_translation.falsified: Preserve and strengthen the distributional reliability of existing component signs/ranks and the US100 positive-return role, without creating an allocation policy.
decision_translation.ambiguous_or_invalid: Make no policy, component or book change; retain only the bounded descriptive concentration record and rotate away.

stop_rules: Commit and push declaration, state and Frontier memory before calculating any top-k share, residual sign, rank reversal, Kendall tau or book residual.
One implementation-only correction is allowed only before any new concentration or residual metric is emitted. After any new metric, make no correction or rerun.
Do not change k, denominator, tie break, basis, component mapping, thresholds, gates, verdicts or decision translation after outcomes.
Do not acquire data, create runtime, modify MQL, compile, run Tester, query broker/account state or touch Live.
